const rows=[
["con-method-divine-supervision","medium",58,"The premise identifies a real circularity risk, but it assumes providence is the only accuracy ground.",55,"The critique is methodological rather than supported here by independent transmission evidence.",72,"It squarely challenges White's appeal to divine oversight as a guarantee of faithful transmission.",78,"This directly bears on whether a supernatural premise can establish the con historical-method burden.",70,"Price distinguishes faith commitment from historical support, though the formulation remains somewhat compressed.",68,"He targets the premise without denying believers may hold it, but understates possible independent corroboration."],
["con-eyewitness-suppression-speculative","high",74,"The move coherently exposes that expected eyewitness correction does not itself prove correction occurred.",65,"Its warrant is the absence of an identified policing mechanism, although absence alone remains limited evidence.",76,"It directly answers the claim that living disciples would reliably prevent invented Jesus traditions.",75,"Undermining eyewitness control materially advances the con burden concerning uncontrolled tradition development.",78,"The circularity charge and the missing-evidence point are expressed distinctly and with useful precision.",70,"The criticism is measured, though it gives little weight to informal correction within close communities."],
["con-paul-distortion-gnostic-reception","high",76,"Contemporary disputes and varied reception consistently support the limited inference that control was imperfect.",72,"Pauline controversy and divergent reception provide concrete analogies, though not direct proof about every gospel.",68,"The move supports Price's broader transmission case but is not tied to one immediate White reply.",77,"Examples of distortion during a teacher's lifetime strongly contact the con tradition-control burden.",73,"The examples and intended inference are understandable, though disparate cases are grouped together.",69,"Price presents counterexamples fairly enough but risks treating disputed Gnostic reception too uniformly."],
["con-temple-saying-variants","medium",70,"Differing placements and evaluations of the temple saying plausibly indicate development, but compatibility remains possible.",73,"The comparison draws on specific canonical treatments rather than a general assertion of contradiction.",64,"It anticipates harmonization more than it answers a developed reply within this selected move.",71,"The concrete textual tension supports the subsidiary con burden against automatic harmonization.",74,"Price identifies the distinct Gospel treatments clearly, despite some uncertainty about exact verbal identity.",62,"Calling the treatments incompatible presses beyond what the variations alone establish and gives harmonization limited room."],
["con-mission-sayings-community-products","medium",68,"Community interests offer a coherent explanation, but the inference from opposed settings to invention is underdetermined.",70,"Matthew 10, Matthew 28, and Acts supply relevant textual data, while authorship by communities remains inferential.",66,"The move raises a focused tension that White later answers, but does not itself anticipate narrative-stage distinctions.",73,"It materially advances the con developmental-composition burden using a prominent mission example.",76,"The alleged opposition and proposed community settings are stated clearly enough to be tested.",58,"Price treats the communal-origin hypothesis as more likely without fully crediting sequential mission contexts."],
["pro-method-analogy-closed-worldview","high",75,"White consistently argues that excluding divine action in advance would make the historical test question-begging.",66,"The warrant comes mainly from Price's stated method; it shows a constraint but not that every use is metaphysical closure.",82,"It directly confronts Price's criticism of providential premises by challenging his alternative method.",80,"This centrally advances the pro burden that supernatural claims remain historically admissible.",79,"The distinction between testing a claim and excluding it is presented forcefully and intelligibly.",64,"White fairly exposes possible closure but sometimes characterizes methodological restraint as a settled worldview denial."],
["pro-composition-inconsistent-source-theory","medium",63,"The general demand that source theories fit authorial purpose and manuscripts is sound but initially programmatic.",57,"This move previews evidential problems rather than yet supplying the detailed manuscript and contextual support.",61,"It addresses Price's compositional approach broadly without engaging a single developed example at this point.",69,"The challenge contacts the central pro textual burden but does less work than the later specific arguments.",65,"White's thesis is recognizable, though the compressed preview leaves 'inconsistent' insufficiently specified.",60,"He signals that Price's reconstruction is theoretical but does not yet represent its strongest internal-evidence basis."],
["pro-manuscript-streams-against-interpolation","high",84,"The expectation that a major insertion leave divergent textual streams is coherent and carries substantial explanatory force.",86,"Universal manuscript inclusion and early branching are concrete external evidence against a late wholesale interpolation.",81,"It directly counters the appeal to uncontrolled transmission by explaining what branching should preserve.",88,"This strongly fulfills the pro burden to defend textual stability at the disputed Pauline passage.",82,"The predicted manuscript consequence and observed record are connected clearly without relying on caption wording.",76,"White acknowledges textual variation while pressing its implications, though very early insertion remains possible."],
["pro-consistent-testing-of-miracles","high",83,"Separating admissibility from acceptance is logically strong and blocks the claimed slide from openness to credulity.",73,"The Mormon First Vision comparison demonstrates a consistent procedure, though it is illustrative rather than decisive evidence.",84,"It directly answers Price's concern that admitting supernatural explanations requires accepting competing miracle reports.",80,"The move substantially supports the pro methodological burden by offering a workable critical standard.",82,"White states the open-but-testing distinction clearly and supplies an intelligible concrete example.",79,"He grants rival claimants an opportunity to harmonize their evidence and does not dismiss them merely by label."],
["con-methodological-atheism-limits","medium",82,"Price coherently distinguishes disciplinary bracketing of untraceable causes from metaphysical denial of their possibility.",70,"The meteorology analogy supports the distinction, though historical evidence can sometimes bear indirectly on unusual causes.",86,"It precisely answers White's closed-worldview charge by explaining what the methodological restriction does and does not assert.",84,"This is central to completing the con burden for a provisional, non-theological historical method.",79,"The discipline-specific limit is clearly expressed, with minor ambiguity about what evidence could overcome it.",82,"Price explicitly allows miracles may occur and calibrates the conclusion as historical agnosticism rather than impossibility."],
["con-ancient-history-provisional","medium",85,"Confidence tracking evidential quantity, proximity, and independence is a consistent and appropriately limited principle.",76,"The contrast with well-corroborated modern events is relevant, though the move supplies no case-specific probability calculation.",80,"It answers White's demand for historical knowledge by offering degrees of confidence rather than global skepticism.",82,"The standard directly supports the con burden to resist certainty where the ancient record is comparatively thin.",84,"Price explains revisability and evidential gradation in accessible terms without confusing uncertainty with ignorance.",88,"The conclusion is carefully limited to provisional judgment and avoids dogmatic denial of biblical events."],
["con-cosmopolitan-source-availability","medium",72,"Coexistence of Jewish and Hellenistic materials coherently defeats a strict either-or cultural premise.",69,"Diaspora interaction and known pagan figures support availability, but availability is weaker than actual literary dependence.",79,"It directly responds to White's claim that Jewish monotheism makes Greek-source composition culturally implausible.",75,"The move advances the con source-plausibility burden while leaving the specific borrowing case incomplete.",77,"The cultural-mixing claim is clear, although the chronology and communities could be delineated more closely.",70,"Price properly limits the point to compatibility, but occasionally slides from cultural contact toward probable influence."],
["con-inspiration-not-required-for-value","medium",86,"Separating ethical or literary value from historical origin is logically clean and avoids a false all-or-nothing choice.",69,"Examples of admired passages regarded as secondary illustrate the claim, though their secondary status is contested.",65,"The move clarifies Price's position rather than answering a central White inference in the immediate exchange.",67,"It helps the subsidiary con reading burden but does not itself establish unreliability or defeat the motion.",85,"The distinction among value, originality, and authorship is unusually clear and useful for evaluating the debate.",89,"Price charitably preserves biblical worth despite critical doubts and does not infer worthlessness from disputed origin."],
["pro-no-standardization-manuscript-variation","medium",83,"The prediction that recent central standardization would reduce early variation is coherent and discriminating.",84,"Wide early papyrus variation is strong evidence against an Uthman-like edition, though survival limitations remain.",82,"It directly answers Price's proposed mechanism for the disappearance of pre-standardized Pauline forms.",87,"The move strongly supports the pro textual burden by testing a specific rival transmission mechanism.",81,"White links standardization to an observable manuscript pattern with clear comparative reasoning.",74,"He grants substantial early diversity, while perhaps treating all possible early editorial events as centralized standardization."],
["pro-cross-saying-contemporary-sense","high",85,"Known Roman crucifixion makes the self-denial and death-march metaphor intelligible before Jesus' own crucifixion.",82,"The public familiarity of crucifixion supplies concrete contextual warrant for a contemporaneous reading.",78,"It answers the broader later-composition inference with a direct alternative explanation for apparent hindsight.",77,"The point supports a subsidiary coherence burden, though it addresses one saying rather than biblical truth generally.",88,"The historical referent and metaphorical force are stated precisely and without dependence on exact caption phrasing.",80,"White allows later resonance while resisting the stronger inference to later origin, a well-calibrated distinction."],
["pro-jewish-monotheism-against-pagan-myth","medium",77,"The argument coherently distinguishes awareness of pagan cults from adopting them as a Messiah-making template.",75,"Jewish monotheistic resistance and the later dating of cited syncretism are relevant, but cultural boundaries were porous.",83,"It directly challenges Price's cosmopolitan-availability answer on acceptance, chronology, and persuasive context.",82,"This materially supports the pro textual burden against a pagan-source explanation of earliest proclamation.",78,"White's availability-versus-adoption distinction is clear, though the range of alleged parallels is treated collectively.",67,"The response recognizes Jewish contact but may characterize the proposed borrowing as more wholesale than Price requires."],
["pro-hadith-temporal-difference","medium",79,"A large difference in collection dates legitimately weakens a simple transmission analogy between Hadith and the New Testament.",76,"The rough 250–270-year comparison supplies relevant evidence, though dating and transmission differences need fuller development.",81,"It directly answers Price's example of invented sayings by identifying a material disanalogy in temporal proximity.",78,"The move advances the pro textual burden by limiting a major analogy for uncontrolled attribution.",75,"The comparative point is understandable, but the exact evidential baselines are summarized rather than fully documented.",72,"White does not dismiss Islamic material outright, yet chronology alone cannot settle the quality of either tradition."],
["pro-mission-context-sequence","high",89,"Distinct pre-resurrection and post-resurrection stages readily reconcile the restricted and universal mission instructions.",84,"The narrative locations and Acts' admitted selectivity provide direct textual warrant for the contextual explanation.",91,"It answers Price's community-product claim point by point: sequence explains scope and silence does not prove absence.",84,"This strongly satisfies the pro subsidiary coherence burden concerning the alleged mission contradiction.",88,"White clearly identifies the differing contexts and the limited inference available from Acts' summary.",82,"The response offers a plausible reconciliation without claiming that unrecorded discussion proves Jesus was invoked."],
["con-pauline-internal-discontinuity","medium",69,"Interpolation can explain abrupt tensions, but the move does not show that contextual reconciliation is less probable.",73,"The cited contrasts about knowledge and women speaking are concrete internal data rather than pure speculation.",72,"It responds to manuscript objections by shifting to internal evidence, though it does not resolve the external-evidence deficit.",76,"The examples materially support the con editorial-development burden, albeit short of establishing compositeness.",70,"Price identifies the alleged discontinuities clearly but compresses complex Pauline contexts into paired propositions.",58,"He gives layered composition priority with limited engagement with genre, audience, or local-context explanations."],
["pro-context-explains-authorial-variation","medium",84,"The analogy correctly shows that stylistic and thematic variation alone does not entail multiple authors.",77,"Price's own differently purposed books offer concrete counterevidence to a simple variation-to-authorship inference.",87,"It directly answers the discontinuity argument by pressing audience, genre, purpose, and immediate context.",82,"The move centrally supports the pro textual burden against premature compositional division.",86,"White states the insufficiency claim and the comparative test with notable clarity.",81,"He does not claim variation proves unity; he appropriately argues that more evidence is required for division."],
["con-pauls-conversion-literary-parallels","low",64,"Absence from Paul's letters plus narrative resemblance can raise suspicion, but neither entails literary construction.",58,"The cited Heliodorus and Pentheus parallels are suggestive, while the low wording confidence limits exact comparison.",74,"It answers White's contextual defense by arguing that complete absence and parallels jointly remain evidential.",70,"The move supports the con tradition burden but does not firmly connect the Acts story to a specific source.",61,"Price's intended analogy is discernible, yet the relevant similarities and differences are not developed precisely.",52,"He leans toward dependence without sufficiently testing common motifs or independent narrative explanations."],
["pro-common-phrase-not-literary-borrowing","medium",86,"Showing the highlighted phrase was conventional sharply undercuts an inference from shared wording to direct dependence.",82,"Multiple Greek uses and the ordinary-idiom analogy provide good warrant that the phrase is non-exclusive.",90,"It directly addresses Price's named verbal parallel rather than changing the subject to general reliability.",78,"The rebuttal supports a subsidiary pro coherence burden, though it does not answer every narrative parallel.",87,"The diagnostic distinction between common idiom and distinctive correspondence is stated very clearly.",83,"White narrows his conclusion to this phrase and does not claim that all proposed parallels are thereby refuted."],
["con-existence-evidence-criterion","medium",78,"Price consistently identifies evidence that would change his mind and infers underdetermination rather than nonexistence.",66,"The absence of a cited contemporary letter matters, but the comparison with other figures is only briefly supported.",85,"It directly rebuts the claim that his method is unfalsifiable by specifying a concrete acceptable attestation.",83,"The move bears directly on the con motion burden by explaining why existence remains unestablished for him.",80,"His evidence threshold and tentative conclusion are clear despite the rapid cross-examination setting.",91,"Price repeatedly disavows certainty and distinguishes leaning mythicist from claiming Jesus definitely did not exist."],
["con-orality-variation-not-verbatim","medium",82,"The distinction between thematic stability and verbatim preservation is coherent and directly relevant to oral transmission.",80,"Parry-Lord performance variation supplies empirical warrant, though application to early Christian communities needs care.",86,"It directly challenges White's use of oral culture as evidence for highly accurate preservation.",84,"This substantially advances the con burden concerning flexible development of Jesus traditions.",78,"Price explains recomposition and sequence variation clearly, notwithstanding a few informal names in speech.",69,"He fairly targets exactness claims but may understate the degree of stable content that oral systems can retain."],
["pro-forgery-needs-pauline-standing","medium",85,"Pseudonymous authority normally presupposes a recognized figure, creating a genuine explanatory burden for wholesale late authorship.",71,"The sociological premise is plausible but not independently documented within the move, and legendary standing could suffice.",90,"It directly presses Price's multiple-forger theory on why Paul's name would carry useful authority.",84,"The challenge centrally supports the pro textual burden by exposing a missing antecedent in the rival account.",85,"White frames the dilemma precisely and asks for the relevant time period before drawing the inference.",78,"He leaves room for Price to identify another source of standing rather than treating the question as dispositive."],
["con-paul-simon-magus-development","medium",57,"A developed Paul-Simon persona could answer the standing problem, but the proposed identification remains highly conjectural.",49,"Later heresiological and Gnostic associations offer clues, not strong evidence that Paul derives from Simon Magus.",82,"It responds directly by proposing how Pauline authority could predate pseudonymous letters without conventional authorship.",66,"The move contacts the con tradition burden but its speculative basis limits how much of that burden it completes.",65,"Price names the proposed links and chronology, though several historical steps remain compressed or implicit.",88,"He expressly calls the reconstruction speculative and presents it as a thought experiment rather than established history."],
["pro-interpolation-needs-lost-streams","high",88,"The interpolation theory incurs a clear additional obligation to explain universal loss across already branching streams.",89,"The absence of any manuscript without the passage and the multiple-stream record provide strong external warrant.",91,"It directly targets the internal-evidence reply by asking what transmission history would produce the surviving record.",90,"This is a central and powerful contribution to the pro burden for textual continuity.",86,"The counterfactual prediction—some stream should preserve omission—is stated with strong precision.",79,"White identifies a serious evidential cost without claiming external attestation makes every early insertion impossible."],
["con-interpolation-internal-fit","medium",73,"Redactional seams and a changed argumentative function form a coherent internal case, but alternative readings remain viable.",72,"The apostolic list, redundancy, and surrounding resurrection argument provide specific textual features for examination.",84,"It directly answers the lost-stream challenge by explaining why Price relies on literary rather than manuscript evidence.",76,"The move advances the con editorial-development burden, though it cannot fully discharge the external-history problem.",78,"Price specifies interruption, credential function, and compromise structure rather than merely asserting interpolation.",67,"He offers a plausible reading but gives limited attention to White's observation that verses 3–11 fit Paul's announced gospel."],
["con-inerrancy-barrier-to-understanding","medium",83,"A rule forbidding error can constrain interpretation, and separating textual value from blanket infallibility is coherent.",72,"The uneven-work and interpretive examples support the methodological concern, though some comparisons are rhetorical.",71,"This is a closing synthesis more than a close reply, but it engages White's dogma-and-context approach.",86,"It directly advances the con motion burden against the broad inspired-infallible understanding of biblical truth.",84,"Price clearly explains how prior dogma can wall off otherwise available readings and preserve value without inerrancy.",85,"He respectfully distinguishes critical interpretation from hostility to the Bible and acknowledges its profundity."],
["pro-consistency-as-truth-test","high",79,"Comparing presuppositions by consistent explanatory performance is reasonable, though consistency alone cannot establish truth.",63,"White shows both sides have commitments, but supplies limited independent evidence that his framework is more consistent here.",78,"It answers Price's asymmetry claim by placing both theological and methodological commitments under scrutiny.",80,"The move centrally supports the pro methodological burden, especially as a closing framework for the dispute.",82,"The proposed comparative test is stated clearly and tied to the two approaches presented in the debate.",67,"White acknowledges his own scriptural commitment, but sometimes treats Price's restraint as a symmetric contrary dogma."],
["pro-scripture-comparative-coherence","medium",75,"Differences as well as parallels must be weighed, and that inference correctly resists motif matching as decisive.",68,"The Apollonius comparison is relevant but reported largely through White's appraisal rather than detailed side-by-side evidence.",80,"It responds to Price's mythology and inerrancy critique by offering critical comparison without prior exclusion.",81,"The move bears directly on the pro motion burden that divine speech remains a live coherent explanation.",76,"White distinguishes superficial parallels from worldview-level differences, though the claimed coherence is not fully itemized.",66,"He permits comparison but may overstate Price's fear of mythology and understate the openness of Price's stated agnosticism."],
["pro-harmony-across-authors","high",68,"Long-range coherence could support unity, but personal discovery of harmony does not by itself establish divine authorship.",61,"White's sustained engagement is relevant testimony, yet the forty-author harmony claim lacks representative demonstrations here.",69,"It answers Price's claim that harmonization is dogmatic by describing harmony as an outcome of critical reading.",73,"The closing affirmation contacts the pro motion burden but leaves the decisive evidential bridge partly experiential.",72,"The scope and personal basis of the claim are clear, although 'harmony' remains broad and insufficiently operationalized.",80,"White presents the point as his reasoned experience after skeptical challenge rather than pretending it is a neutral proof."]
];
